description: Polytab Event Radar queue. Current events surfaced from free public feeds (GDELT, CDC Newsroom, USGS) as candidate civic-action blocks in the exact Polytab block format. All metrics are honest-zero (fundedUSD=0, votesCount=0). Items are PROPOSED — promotion to the Action Shelf (feed.json) requires a verified organization pairing and governance sign-off, never automatic. Wallet series: 0x71E + ID (601+). No coordinates are stored (lat/lng null); locations are public place-name strings only.
